articles.title: AI compute provider Nscale is looking for $3.5B in pre-IPO financing
articles.summary: Nscale, which recently struck a $45 billion deal with Anthropic, is in talks to raise additional funds in anticipation of an upcoming IPO.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: Anthropic Builds Its War Chest Ahead of IPO | Bloomberg Tech 9/04/2026
articles.summary: Bloomberg’s Lisa Mateo takes a look at Anthropic as it finalizes an expansion of its revolving credit facility to $15 billion before its anticipated public filing. Plus, a look at the latest US jobs report showing the IT sector shed 23,000 jobs in August; and Apple is kicking off the John Ternus era with what could be the biggest run of new devices in its history. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Anthropic’s $15 Billion Credit Line Sets Stage for IPO
articles.summary: Anthropic’s anticipated IPO could kick off a busy fall for tech listings after SpaceX dominated the market this summer. Rainmaker Securities co-founder and Managing Director Greg Martin discusses why Anthropic’s planned $15 billion revolving credit facility strengthens its position ahead of a potential offering. He also shares how its rapid growth could support a valuation above SpaceX’s at IPO and why a successful debut could “open the floodgates” for companies including Oura, neoclouds and other long-awaited tech listings. He joins Bloomberg’s Lisa Mateo on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Anthropic’s $2 trillion IPO puts powerful external trustees in spotlight
articles.summary: Public-market scrutiny will intensify pressure on the Claude maker’s unusual attempt to balance profit and purpose.
articles.author: Madhumita Murgia, Financial Times

articles.title: China’s Moonshot Said to Seek Up to $5 Billion in Hong Kong IPO This Year
articles.summary: Moonshot AI is considering raising up to $5 billion in its planned Hong Kong initial public offering as soon as this year, people familiar with the matter said, as the Chinese artificial intelligence champion taps into strong investor demand.
articles.author: Dong Cao, Julia Fioretti, Pei Li and Luz Ding

articles.title: AMC Boss Slams Robinhood, Calls Stock Token ‘Quasi-Fake’
articles.summary: AMC Entertainment Holdings Inc. boss Adam Aron criticized Robinhood Markets Inc. after the platform launched a tokenized version of the theater chain’s shares, escalating a debate over synthetic equities as Wall Street pushes toward always-on markets.
articles.author: Sidhartha Shukla

articles.title: Crusoe Raises Over $3 Billion in Funding at $30 Billion Valuation
articles.summary: Crusoe, a cloud-computing provider and data center developer doing business with OpenAI, Microsoft Corp. and Meta Platforms Inc., has raised over $3 billion in a funding round that values the startup at roughly $30 billion, according to people familiar with the situation.
articles.author: Rebecca Torrence, Dina Bass and Edward Ludlow

articles.title: Broadcom Forecasts Boom in AI Chip Sales
articles.summary: Broadcom predicted a surge in artificial intelligence chip sales over the next two years, helping renew optimism that it can challenge Nvidia’s dominance in the lucrative market. The company also is on track to top earnings of $30 a share in fiscal 2028, outpacing Wall Street estimates. Bloomberg Intelligence analyst Matt Bloxham has the details. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Beyond the Model: The Unlikely Architecture of the AI Winners
articles.summary: There is no single "winner" of the AI space. While labs like OpenAI and Anthropic fight over the model layer, the real, durable victory is happening in the plumbing. Compute (NVIDIA), inference (vLLM), and economic routing (Stripe's acquisition of OpenRouter) are proving far more valuable and stable than the AI models themselves, positioning infrastructure as the true king of the AI boom.Read All
articles.author: Olaoluwa Afolabi

articles.title: Tencent-Backed Enflame’s IPO Draws 4,073 Times Retail Demand
articles.summary: The initial public offering of Shanghai Enflame Technology Co., a company backed by Tencent Holdings Ltd., drew strong demand from retail investors, as the last of the so-called “four little dragons” of leading Chinese artificial intelligence chipmakers taps the public market.
articles.author: Bloomberg News

articles.title: Lyte Closes $165 Million Round, Bringing AI Startup's Valuation to $1.6 Billion
articles.summary: Lyte, a fast-growing robotics and artificial intelligence startup from top members of Apple Inc.'s Face ID team, has secured about $165 million in a new funding round that more than triples the company’s valuation to $1.6 billion.
articles.author: Samantha Kelly
